00416 C            05  REQ-KIND              PIC X(3).
00417 C            05  REQ-DIR               PIC X.

00435 C       * 1000-BYTE LIMIT (TEST OF THE SIZE GUARD). RESOLVED: 4/3/T/N.

00438 C       * D OR BLANK DEFAULT 80 X 24; TSD ONLY: W X T M U L = SIMULATED.
00439 C       * REQ-CW / REQ-CH = THE RESOLVED BUFFER SIZE (0 = 80 X 24).

00441 C            05  REQ-CW                PIC 999.

00443          01  PAC-DS COPY PACDS.
00444 C       * 3270 DATA STREAM BUFFER PASSED FROM PACSCR TO PACPLAT (SEND).
00445 C        01  PAC-DS.
00446 C            05  DS-LEN                PIC S9(4) COMP.
00447 C            05  DS-BUF.
00448 C                10  DS-BYTE           PIC X OCCURS 2048 TIMES.
00449 C            05  DS-KIND               PIC X.
00450          PROCEDURE DIVISION USING PAC-STATE PAC-REQ PAC-DS.
00451          MAIN-PARA.
00452              IF TAB-OK = 0
00453                  PERFORM INIT-TAB.   9


00454              IF SC-INIT = 0
00455                  PERFORM INIT-SCALE.
00456              MOVE 0 TO DS-OVF.
00457              IF REQ-OP = 'INVL'
00458                  MOVE 1 TO MSG-ON
00459                  MOVE REQ-CHAR TO INV-CHAR
00460              ELSE IF REQ-OP = 'PRMT'
00461                  PERFORM DO-PRMT THRU DO-PRMT-EXIT
00462              ELSE IF REQ-OP = 'TICK'
00463                  PERFORM DO-TICK THRU DO-TICK-EXIT
00464              ELSE IF REQ-OP = 'FULL'
00465                  PERFORM DO-FULL THRU DO-FULL-EXIT
00466              ELSE IF REQ-OP = 'ENDS'
00467                  PERFORM DO-ENDS THRU DO-ENDS-EXIT.
00468              GOBACK.
00469          DO-PRMT.
00470              MOVE 0 TO DS-LEN.
00471              MOVE 'F' TO DS-KIND.
00472              PERFORM INIT-HI.
00473              IF REQ-ANIM = 'Y'
00474                  PERFORM TOGGLE-VIS.
00475              PERFORM SET-FACE.
00476              PERFORM SET-GLYPHS.
00477              PERFORM PRMT-BODY.
00478         * MVS-GS SIZE GUARD: A SCREEN THAT DID NOT FIT IS REPLACED BY THE
00479         * NEXT LAYOUT DOWN (W/T -> B -> G4) FOR THE REST OF THE GAME.
00480              PERFORM PRMT-RETRY UNTIL DS-OVF = 0.
00481              MOVE MSG-ON TO MSG-LAST.
00482              MOVE 0 TO MSG-ON.
00483          DO-PRMT-EXIT.
00484              EXIT.
00485          PRMT-RETRY.
00486              PERFORM LAYOUT-DOWN.
00487              PERFORM SET-GLYPHS.
00488              PERFORM PRMT-BODY.
00489          PRMT-BODY.
00490              IF REQ-REDRAW = 'P'
00491                  PERFORM PRMT-VS
00492              ELSE
00493                  PERFORM COMPOSE.
00494              MOVE 0 TO WS-NOP.
00495          PRMT-VS.
00496         * VIRTUAL IMAGE FIRST; FULL SCREEN WHEN THE TERMINAL HAS NOTHING
00497         * KNOWN (FIRST SCREEN) OR THE LAST INPUT WAS A REDRAW REQUEST.
00498              PERFORM BUILD-VS.
00499              IF PREV-OK = 1 AND REQ-KIND NOT = 'RDR'
00500                  PERFORM BUILD-PARTIAL.
00501              IF PREV-OK = 0 OR REQ-KIND = 'RDR'
00502                  PERFORM COMPOSE.
00503              PERFORM KEEP-VS.
00504          DO-FULL.
00505              MOVE 0 TO DS-LEN.
00506              PERFORM INIT-HI.
00507              PERFORM SET-GLYPHS.
00508              MOVE MSG-LAST TO MSG-ON.
00509              PERFORM COMPOSE.
00510              PERFORM FULL-RETRY UNTIL DS-OVF = 0.  10


00511              MOVE 0 TO MSG-ON.
00512              MOVE 0 TO PREV-OK.
00513          DO-FULL-EXIT.
00514              EXIT.
00515          FULL-RETRY.
00516              PERFORM LAYOUT-DOWN.
00517              PERFORM SET-GLYPHS.
00518              PERFORM COMPOSE.
00519          DO-TICK.
00520              MOVE 0 TO DS-LEN.
00521              IF REQ-ANIM = 'Y' AND REQ-REDRAW = 'P' AND PREV-OK = 1
00522                                AND SC-ON = 1
00523                  PERFORM TICK-BUILD-S
00524              ELSE IF REQ-ANIM = 'Y' AND REQ-REDRAW = 'P'
00525                                AND PREV-OK = 1
00526                  PERFORM TICK-BUILD.
00527         * A TICK THAT DID NOT FIT: FULL SCREEN OF THE NEXT LAYOUT DOWN.
00528              PERFORM TICK-RETRY UNTIL DS-OVF = 0.
00529          DO-TICK-EXIT.
00530              EXIT.
00531          TICK-RETRY.
00532              PERFORM LAYOUT-DOWN.
00533              PERFORM SET-GLYPHS.
00534              MOVE MSG-LAST TO MSG-ON.
00535              PERFORM PRMT-VS.
00536              MOVE 0 TO MSG-ON.
00537          DO-ENDS.
00538         * MVS-GS FINAL SCREEN (SCALED ONLY): THE LAST BOARD WITH THE END
00539         * BANNER ON THE MESSAGE ROW, ALWAYS A FULL SCREEN. NOT SCALED (OR
00540         * NOT FITTING): NOTHING (DS-LEN 0), AS BEFORE MVS-GS.
00541              MOVE 0 TO DS-LEN.
00542              IF SC-ON = 0
00543                  GO TO DO-ENDS-EXIT.
00544              PERFORM INIT-HI.
00545              PERFORM SET-FACE.
00546              PERFORM SET-GLYPHS.
00547              MOVE 0 TO MSG-ON.
00548              MOVE 1 TO BAN-ON.
00549              PERFORM COMPOSE.
00550              MOVE 0 TO BAN-ON.
00551              PERFORM ENDS-RETRY UNTIL DS-OVF = 0 OR SC-ON = 0.
00552          DO-ENDS-EXIT.
00553              EXIT.
00554          ENDS-RETRY.
00555              PERFORM LAYOUT-DOWN.
00556              IF SC-ON = 1
00557                  PERFORM SET-GLYPHS
00558                  MOVE 1 TO BAN-ON
00559                  PERFORM COMPOSE
00560                  MOVE 0 TO BAN-ON.
00561              MOVE 0 TO WS-NOP.
00562          INIT-SCALE.
00563         * MVS-GS: SCALING AS RESOLVED BY PACPLAT (4, 3, T; ANYTHING ELSE
00564         * IS OFF) AND THE BUFFER GEOMETRY (REQ-CW X REQ-CH, 0 = 80 X 24).
00565         * THE G1-G4 LAYOUT IS KEPT FOR A LATER FALLBACK.
00566              MOVE 1 TO SC-INIT.
00567              MOVE SPR-4 TO SPR-4-T.  11


00568              MOVE SPR-3 TO SPR-3-T.
00569              MOVE LAY-STATUS-ROW TO SV-STATUS-ROW.
00570              MOVE LAY-GHOSTS-ROW TO SV-GHOSTS-ROW.
00571              MOVE LAY-GHOSTS-COL TO SV-GHOSTS-COL.
00572              MOVE LAY-MSG-ROW TO SV-MSG-ROW.
00573              MOVE LAY-CMD-ROW TO SV-CMD-ROW.
00574              MOVE LAY-HELP-ROW TO SV-HELP-ROW.
00575              MOVE LAY-HELP-COL TO SV-HELP-COL.
00576              MOVE LAY-SF-ROW TO SV-SF-ROW.
00577              MOVE LAY-MSG-COL TO SV-MSG-COL.
00578              MOVE LAY-CMD-COL TO SV-CMD-COL.
00579              MOVE LAY-STATUS-COL TO SV-STATUS-COL.
00580              MOVE WS-HELP-TXT TO WS-HELP-G.
00581              MOVE 80 TO GW.
00582              MOVE 24 TO GH.
00583              IF REQ-CW > 0 AND REQ-CH > 0
00584                  MOVE REQ-CW TO GW
00585                  MOVE REQ-CH TO GH.
00586              COMPUTE G-CELLS = GW * GH.
00587              MOVE GH TO VS-ROWS.
00588              IF G-CELLS > 4095
00589                  COMPUTE VS-ROWS = 4094 / GW.
00590              COMPUTE VS-N = GW * VS-ROWS.
00591              IF REQ-SCALE = '4' OR REQ-SCALE = '3' OR REQ-SCALE = 'T'
00592                  PERFORM SCALE-ON.
00593              IF SC-ON = 0
00594                  MOVE 'N' TO REQ-SCALE.
00595              PERFORM SET-FAMILY.
00596          SCALE-ON.
00597              MOVE 1 TO SC-ON.
00598              MOVE 4 TO SC-W.
00599              IF REQ-SCALE = '3'
00600                  MOVE 3 TO SC-W.
00601              IF REQ-SCALE = 'T'
00602                  MOVE 1000 TO DS-LIMIT.
00603              MOVE 0 TO WS-NOP.
00604          SET-FAMILY.
00605         * W: 4X2 AND >= 120 X 27; T: 4X2 AND >= 32 ROWS; B: SCALED, ANY
00606         * OTHER BUFFER; G: NOT SCALED.
00607              IF SC-ON = 1 AND SC-W = 4 AND GW > 119 AND VS-ROWS > 26
00608                  PERFORM FAM-W
00609              ELSE IF SC-ON = 1 AND SC-W = 4 AND VS-ROWS > 31
00610                  PERFORM FAM-T
00611              ELSE IF SC-ON = 1
00612                  PERFORM FAM-B
00613              ELSE
00614                  PERFORM FAM-G.
00615              MOVE 0 TO WS-NOP.
00616          FAM-CENTRE.
00617              COMPUTE ORG-R = (VS-ROWS - 24) / 2 + 1.
00618              COMPUTE ORG-C = (GW - 80) / 2 + 1.
00619          FAM-G.
00620              MOVE 'G' TO FAM.
00621              PERFORM FAM-CENTRE.
00622              MOVE SV-STATUS-ROW TO LAY-STATUS-ROW.
00623              MOVE SV-GHOSTS-ROW TO LAY-GHOSTS-ROW.
00624              MOVE SV-GHOSTS-COL TO LAY-GHOSTS-COL.  12


00625              MOVE SV-MSG-ROW TO LAY-MSG-ROW.
00626              MOVE SV-CMD-ROW TO LAY-CMD-ROW.
00627              MOVE SV-HELP-ROW TO LAY-HELP-ROW.
00628              MOVE SV-HELP-COL TO LAY-HELP-COL.
00629              MOVE SV-SF-ROW TO LAY-SF-ROW.
00630              MOVE SV-MSG-COL TO LAY-MSG-COL.

01117                  MOVE PAL-GHOST-1 TO CELL-COL (WS-GX).
01118              IF WS-G = 2
01119                  MOVE PAL-GHOST-2 TO CELL-COL (WS-GX).
01120              IF WS-G = 3
01121                  MOVE PAL-GHOST-3 TO CELL-COL (WS-GX).
01122          OVERLAY-GHOST-EXIT.
01123              EXIT.
01124          PUT-CELL.
01125         * A COLOUR ORDER ONLY WHEN A VISIBLE CELL CHANGES COLOUR.
01126              IF CELL-COL (WS-COL) NOT = 0
01127                                AND CELL-COL (WS-COL) NOT = WS-CUR
01128                  MOVE CELL-COL (WS-COL) TO WS-CUR
01129                  MOVE WS-CUR TO WS-BV
01130                  PERFORM PUT-COLOUR.
01131              IF CELL-HI (WS-COL) NOT = WS-HCUR
01132                  MOVE CELL-HI (WS-COL) TO WS-HCUR
01133                  MOVE WS-HCUR TO WS-HV
01134                  PERFORM PUT-HILITE.
01135              IF CELL-GE (WS-COL) = 1
01136                  MOVE 8 TO WS-BV
01137                  PERFORM PUT-BYTE.  21


01138              MOVE LINE-CH (WS-COL) TO WS-CHB.
01139              PERFORM PUT-CHB.
01140          SHOW-MESSAGE.
01141              MOVE LAY-MSG-ROW TO WS-ROW.
01142              MOVE LAY-MSG-COL TO WS-COL.
01143              PERFORM PUT-SBA.
01144              MOVE PAL-ERROR TO WS-BV.
01145              PERFORM PUT-COLOUR.
01146              IF WS-HE NOT = 0
01147                  MOVE WS-HE TO WS-HV
01148                  PERFORM PUT-HILITE.
01149              MOVE WS-INV TO WS-TXT.
01150              MOVE 17 TO WS-TLEN.
01151              PERFORM PUT-TEXT.
01152              IF WS-HE NOT = 0
01153                  MOVE 0 TO WS-HV
01154                  PERFORM PUT-HILITE.
01155              MOVE 0 TO WS-HV.
01156          SHOW-COMMAND.
01157         * COMMAND ===> THEN A 1-BYTE UNPROTECTED FIELD WITH THE CURSOR.
01158              MOVE LAY-CMD-ROW TO WS-ROW.
01159              MOVE LAY-CMD-COL TO WS-COL.
01160              PERFORM PUT-SBA.
01161              MOVE PAL-HELP TO WS-BV.
01162              PERFORM PUT-COLOUR.
01163              MOVE WS-CMD-TXT TO WS-TXT.
01164              MOVE 12 TO WS-TLEN.
01165              PERFORM PUT-TEXT.
01166          SHOW-FIELD.
01167              MOVE 29 TO WS-BV.
01168              PERFORM PUT-BYTE.
01169              MOVE 64 TO WS-BV.
01170              PERFORM PUT-BYTE.
01171              IF WS-HN NOT = 0
01172                  MOVE WS-HN TO WS-HV
01173                  PERFORM PUT-HILITE.
01174              MOVE 19 TO WS-BV.
01175              PERFORM PUT-BYTE.
01176              MOVE 64 TO WS-BV.
01177              PERFORM PUT-BYTE.
01178              IF WS-HN NOT = 0
01179                  MOVE 0 TO WS-HV
01180                  PERFORM PUT-HILITE.
01181              MOVE 29 TO WS-BV.
01182              PERFORM PUT-BYTE.
01183              MOVE 96 TO WS-BV.
01184              PERFORM PUT-BYTE.
01185          SHOW-HELP.
01186              MOVE LAY-HELP-ROW TO WS-ROW.
01187              MOVE LAY-HELP-COL TO WS-COL.
01188              PERFORM PUT-SBA.
01189              MOVE PAL-HELP TO WS-BV.
01190              PERFORM PUT-COLOUR.
01191              MOVE WS-HELP-TXT TO WS-TXT.
01192              MOVE 48 TO WS-TLEN.
01193              PERFORM PUT-TEXT.
01194          PUT-SBA.  22


01195         * LAYOUT ROW/COLUMN -> BUFFER CELL VS-POS (ORIGIN ORG-R/ORG-C IN A
01196         * GW-WIDE BUFFER; 80 X 24 AT (1,1) = THE G1-GS ADDRESSES).
01197              COMPUTE VS-POS = (ORG-R + WS-ROW - 2) * GW + ORG-C
01198                  + WS-COL - 1.
01199              PERFORM PUT-SBA-AT.
01200          PUT-SBA-AT.
01201              MOVE 0 TO VS-COL.
01202              MOVE 0 TO VS-HI.
01203              COMPUTE WS-ADDR = VS-POS - 1.
01204              DIVIDE WS-ADDR BY 64 GIVING WS-HI REMAINDER WS-LO.
01205              ADD 1 TO WS-HI.
01206              ADD 1 TO WS-LO.
01207              IF VS-MODE = 0
01208                  MOVE 17 TO WS-BV
01209                  PERFORM PUT-BYTE
01210                  MOVE ADDR-CODE (WS-HI) TO WS-BV
01211                  PERFORM PUT-BYTE
01212                  MOVE ADDR-CODE (WS-LO) TO WS-BV
01213                  PERFORM PUT-BYTE.
01214              MOVE 0 TO WS-NOP.
01215          PUT-COLOUR.
01216              MOVE WS-BV TO WS-CUR.
01217              MOVE WS-BV TO VS-COL.
01218              IF VS-MODE = 0
01219                  MOVE 40 TO WS-BV
01220                  PERFORM PUT-BYTE
01221                  MOVE 66 TO WS-BV
01222                  PERFORM PUT-BYTE
01223                  MOVE WS-CUR TO WS-BV
01224                  PERFORM PUT-BYTE.
01225              MOVE 0 TO WS-NOP.
01226          PUT-HILITE.
01227         * SA X'41' + VALUE IN WS-HV (0 = DEFAULT, ENDS A HIGHLIGHT RUN).
01228              MOVE WS-HV TO VS-HI.
01229              IF VS-MODE = 0
01230                  MOVE 40 TO WS-BV
01231                  PERFORM PUT-BYTE
01232                  MOVE 65 TO WS-BV
01233                  PERFORM PUT-BYTE
01234                  MOVE WS-HV TO WS-BV
01235                  PERFORM PUT-BYTE.
01236              MOVE 0 TO WS-NOP.
01237          PUT-TEXT.
01238              PERFORM PUT-CHAR VARYING WS-I FROM 1 BY 1
01239                  UNTIL WS-I > WS-TLEN.
01240          PUT-CHAR.
01241              IF VS-MODE = 1
01242                  PERFORM VS-CHAR
01243              ELSE
01244                  MOVE TXT-CH (WS-I) TO WS-CHB
01245                  PERFORM PUT-CHB.
01246              MOVE 0 TO WS-NOP.
01247          VS-CHAR.
01248              MOVE TXT-CH (WS-I) TO CU-CH (VS-POS).
01249              MOVE VS-COL TO CU-CO (VS-POS).
01250              MOVE VS-HI TO CU-HI (VS-POS).
01251              MOVE 0 TO CU-CS (VS-POS).  23


01252              IF TXT-CH (WS-I) = SPACE
01253                  MOVE 0 TO CU-CO (VS-POS)
01254                  MOVE 0 TO CU-HI (VS-POS).
01255              ADD 1 TO VS-POS.
01256          PUT-BYTE.
01257              MOVE WS-BV TO BW-N.
01258              MOVE BW-L TO WS-CHB.
01259              PERFORM PUT-CHB.
01260          PUT-CHB.
01261         * MVS-GS SIZE GUARD: NEVER BEYOND DS-LIMIT (2048 = PAC-DS AND THE
01262         * PACFSIO BUFFER); A STREAM THAT WOULD BE LONGER IS FLAGGED.
01263              IF DS-LEN < DS-LIMIT
01264                  ADD 1 TO DS-LEN
01265                  MOVE WS-CHB TO DS-BYTE (DS-LEN)
01266              ELSE
01267                  MOVE 1 TO DS-OVF.
01268              MOVE 0 TO WS-NOP.
01269         * ---------------------------------------------------------------
01270         * MVS-GS SCALED BOARD: LOGICAL ROW CY -> 2 IMAGE ROWS OF TILES.
01271          SCALED-ROW.
01272              MOVE CY TO WS-I.
01273              MOVE MAP-ROW (CY) TO WS-LINE.
01274              PERFORM BASE-COLOUR THRU BASE-COLOUR-EXIT
01275                  VARYING WS-COL FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL WS-COL > 20.
01276              IF CY = PLAYER-Y
01277                  MOVE 'P' TO LINE-CH (PLAYER-X)
01278                  MOVE PAL-PLAYER TO CELL-COL (PLAYER-X).
01279              PERFORM OVERLAY-GHOST THRU OVERLAY-GHOST-EXIT
01280                  VARYING WS-G FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL WS-G > GHOST-COUNT.
01281              PERFORM S-TILE VARYING CX FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL CX > 20.
01282          S-TILE.
01283              MOVE LINE-CH (CX) TO TL-KIND.
01284              MOVE CELL-COL (CX) TO TL-COL.
01285              PERFORM S-SUB VARYING SR FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL SR > 2
01286                  AFTER SC FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL SC > SC-W.
01287          S-SUB.
01288              MOVE SPACE TO TL-CH.
01289              MOVE 0 TO TL-CO.
01290              MOVE 0 TO TL-HI.
01291              MOVE 0 TO TL-CS.
01292              IF TL-KIND = '#'
01293                  PERFORM S-WALL
01294              ELSE IF TL-KIND = '.'
01295                  PERFORM S-PELLET
01296              ELSE IF TL-KIND = 'P'
01297                  MOVE SPR-PAC TO SPR-NO
01298                  PERFORM S-SPRITE
01299              ELSE IF TL-KIND = 'G'
01300                  MOVE SPR-GH TO SPR-NO
01301                  PERFORM S-SPRITE.
01302              COMPUTE VS-POS = (SC-BROW - 1 + (CY - 1) * 2 + SR - 1) * GW
01303                  + SC-BCOL + (CX - 1) * SC-W + SC - 1.
01304              MOVE TL-CH TO CU-CH (VS-POS).
01305              MOVE TL-CO TO CU-CO (VS-POS).
01306              MOVE TL-HI TO CU-HI (VS-POS).
01307              MOVE TL-CS TO CU-CS (VS-POS).
01308          S-WALL.  24


01309              COMPUTE CT-K = ((CY - 1) * 20 + CX - 1) * 8
01310                  + (SR - 1) * 4 + SC.
01311              IF CT-CODE (CT-K) NOT = 0
01312                  MOVE CT-CODE (CT-K) TO BW-N
01313                  MOVE BW-L TO TL-CH
01314                  MOVE PAL-WALL TO TL-CO
01315                  MOVE 1 TO TL-CS.
01316              MOVE 0 TO WS-NOP.
01317          S-PELLET.
01318              IF SR = 1 AND SC = LS-PEL-COL
01319                  MOVE X-PEL-G TO TL-CH
01320                  MOVE PAL-PELLET TO TL-CO
01321                  MOVE 1 TO TL-CS.
01322              MOVE 0 TO WS-NOP.
01323          S-SPRITE.
01324         * F = BLANK IN REVERSE, T/B = UPPER/LOWER HALF BLOCK, E = EYE IN
01325         * REVERSE (GE CODES FROM PACPAL), ' ' = BLANK. COLOUR OF THE CELL.
01326              IF SC-W = 4
01327                  COMPUTE E-K = ((SPR-NO - 1) * 2 + SR - 1) * 4 + SC
01328                  MOVE SPR-4-CH (E-K) TO SPR-C
01329              ELSE
01330                  COMPUTE E-K = ((SPR-NO - 1) * 2 + SR - 1) * 3 + SC
01331                  MOVE SPR-3-CH (E-K) TO SPR-C.
01332              IF SPR-C NOT = SPACE
01333                  MOVE TL-COL TO TL-CO.
01334              IF SPR-C = 'F' OR SPR-C = 'E'
01335                  MOVE HI-PLAYER TO TL-HI.
01336              IF SPR-C = 'T'
01337                  MOVE SG-UPPER TO BW-N.
01338              IF SPR-C = 'B'
01339                  MOVE SG-LOWER TO BW-N.
01340              IF SPR-C = 'E'
01341                  MOVE SG-EYE TO BW-N.
01342              IF SPR-C = 'T' OR SPR-C = 'B' OR SPR-C = 'E'
01343                  MOVE BW-L TO TL-CH
01344                  MOVE 1 TO TL-CS.
01345              MOVE 0 TO WS-NOP.
01346         * WALL CONTOUR TABLE, BUILT ONCE (WALLS NEVER CHANGE): 8 CODES PER
01347         * LOGICAL CELL (ROW 1 AT +1..+W, ROW 2 AT +5..+4+W), 0 = BLANK.
01348         * A NEIGHBOUR OUTSIDE THE MAP COUNTS AS OPEN (DOUBLE BORDER).
01349          CT-INIT.
01350              MOVE ALL '0' TO CT-TABLE.
01351              PERFORM CT-CELL THRU CT-CELL-EXIT
01352                  VARYING CY FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL CY > 10
01353                  AFTER CX FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL CX > 20.
01354              MOVE 1 TO CT-OK.
01355          CT-CELL.
01356              IF MAP-CELL (CY, CX) NOT = '#'
01357                  GO TO CT-CELL-EXIT.
01358              MOVE CX TO WX.
01359              COMPUTE WY = CY - 1.
01360              PERFORM GET-W.
01361              MOVE WW TO NB-N.
01362              COMPUTE WY = CY + 1.
01363              PERFORM GET-W.
01364              MOVE WW TO NB-S.
01365              COMPUTE WX = CX - 1.  25


01366              PERFORM GET-W.
01367              MOVE WW TO NB-SW.
01368              MOVE CY TO WY.
01369              PERFORM GET-W.
01370              MOVE WW TO NB-W.
01371              COMPUTE WY = CY - 1.
01372              PERFORM GET-W.
01373              MOVE WW TO NB-NW.
01374              COMPUTE WX = CX + 1.
01375              PERFORM GET-W.
01376              MOVE WW TO NB-NE.
01377              MOVE CY TO WY.
01378              PERFORM GET-W.
01379              MOVE WW TO NB-E.
01380              COMPUTE WY = CY + 1.
01381              PERFORM GET-W.
01382              MOVE WW TO NB-SE.
01383              COMPUTE CT-BASE = ((CY - 1) * 20 + CX - 1) * 8.
01384              MOVE NB-N TO CN-V.
01385              MOVE NB-W TO CN-H.
01386              MOVE NB-NW TO CN-D.
01387              MOVE SG-TL TO CN-OUT.
01388              MOVE SG-BR TO CN-IN.
01389              COMPUTE CT-K = CT-BASE + 1.
01390              PERFORM CORNER.
01391              MOVE NB-E TO CN-H.
01392              MOVE NB-NE TO CN-D.
01393              MOVE SG-TR TO CN-OUT.
01394              MOVE SG-BL TO CN-IN.
01395              COMPUTE CT-K = CT-BASE + SC-W.
01396              PERFORM CORNER.
01397              MOVE NB-S TO CN-V.
01398              MOVE NB-W TO CN-H.
01399              MOVE NB-SW TO CN-D.
01400              MOVE SG-BL TO CN-OUT.
01401              MOVE SG-TR TO CN-IN.
01402              COMPUTE CT-K = CT-BASE + 5.
01403              PERFORM CORNER.
01404              MOVE NB-E TO CN-H.
01405              MOVE NB-SE TO CN-D.
01406              MOVE SG-BR TO CN-OUT.
01407              MOVE SG-TL TO CN-IN.
01408              COMPUTE CT-K = CT-BASE + 4 + SC-W.
01409              PERFORM CORNER.
01410              PERFORM CT-EDGE VARYING SC FROM 2 BY 1 UNTIL SC = SC-W.
01411          CT-CELL-EXIT.
01412              EXIT.
01413          CT-EDGE.
01414              IF NB-N = 0
01415                  COMPUTE CT-K = CT-BASE + SC
01416                  MOVE SG-HLINE TO CT-CODE (CT-K).
01417              IF NB-S = 0
01418                  COMPUTE CT-K = CT-BASE + 4 + SC
01419                  MOVE SG-HLINE TO CT-CODE (CT-K).
01420              MOVE 0 TO WS-NOP.
01421          CORNER.
01422              MOVE 0 TO CN-RES.  26


01423              IF CN-V = 0 AND CN-H = 0
01424                  MOVE CN-OUT TO CN-RES
01425              ELSE IF CN-V = 0
01426                  MOVE SG-HLINE TO CN-RES
01427              ELSE IF CN-H = 0
01428                  MOVE SG-VLINE TO CN-RES
01429              ELSE IF CN-D = 0
01430                  MOVE CN-IN TO CN-RES.
01431              MOVE CN-RES TO CT-CODE (CT-K).
01432          GET-W.
01433              MOVE 0 TO WW.
01434              IF WX > 0 AND WX < 21 AND WY > 0 AND WY < 11
01435                  PERFORM GET-W2.
01436              MOVE 0 TO WS-NOP.
01437          GET-W2.
01438              IF MAP-CELL (WY, WX) = '#'
01439                  MOVE 1 TO WW.
01440              MOVE 0 TO WS-NOP.
01441         * MVS-GS END BANNER ON THE MESSAGE ROW (REVERSE, ITS COLOUR).
01442          SHOW-BANNER.
01443              MOVE ' END OF INPUT ' TO WS-BAN.
01444              MOVE 14 TO BAN-LEN.
01445              MOVE PAL-HELP TO BAN-CO.
01446              IF F-QUIT = 1
01447                  MOVE ' QUIT ' TO WS-BAN
01448                  MOVE 6 TO BAN-LEN.
01449              IF F-WON = 1
01450                  MOVE ' YOU WIN ' TO WS-BAN
01451                  MOVE 9 TO BAN-LEN
01452                  MOVE PAL-PLAYER TO BAN-CO.
01453              IF F-LOST = 1
01454                  MOVE ' GAME OVER ' TO WS-BAN
01455                  MOVE 11 TO BAN-LEN
01456                  MOVE PAL-ERROR TO BAN-CO.
01457              COMPUTE VS-POS = (ORG-R + LAY-MSG-ROW - 2) * GW + ORG-C
01458                  + LAY-MSG-COL - 1.
01459              PERFORM BAN-CELL VARYING E-K FROM 1 BY 1
01460                  UNTIL E-K > BAN-LEN.
01461          BAN-CELL.
01462              MOVE BAN-CH (E-K) TO CU-CH (VS-POS).
01463              MOVE BAN-CO TO CU-CO (VS-POS).
01464              MOVE HI-PLAYER TO CU-HI (VS-POS).
01465              MOVE 0 TO CU-CS (VS-POS).
01466              ADD 1 TO VS-POS.
01467         * MVS-GS FULL-SCREEN ENCODER (IMAGE -> STREAM): SBA ONLY WHERE
01468         * THE ADDRESS JUMPS, SA ONLY ON A CHANGE, GE BEFORE CP310 CODES,
01469         * RA FOR A RUN OF EQUAL CELLS WHEN SHORTER, RUNS OF 4+ BLANKS
01470         * SKIPPED (PACFSIO'S CLEAR PREFIX NULLS THE BUFFER). FIELD AT THE
01471         * FIRST SF CELL AND AT THE COMMAND FIELD, AS IN THE G1 SCREENS.
01472          ENCODE-S.
01473              MOVE 195 TO WS-BV.
01474              PERFORM PUT-BYTE.
01475              COMPUTE E-SP1 = (ORG-R + LAY-SF-ROW - 2) * GW + ORG-C.
01476              COMPUTE E-SPF = (ORG-R + LAY-CMD-ROW - 2) * GW + ORG-C
01477                  + LAY-CMD-COL + 11.
01478              MOVE 0 TO EC-CO.
01479              MOVE 0 TO EC-HI.  27


01480              MOVE 0 TO EPOS.
01481              MOVE 1 TO EA.
01482              PERFORM ENC-STEP UNTIL EA > VS-N.
01483              IF EC-HI NOT = 0
01484                  MOVE 0 TO WS-HV
01485                  PERFORM PUT-HILITE.
01486              PERFORM PUT-TAIL.
01487          ENC-STEP.
01488              IF EA = E-SP1
01489                  PERFORM ENC-SF1
01490              ELSE IF EA = E-SPF
01491                  PERFORM ENC-FLD
01492              ELSE
01493                  PERFORM ENC-RUN THRU ENC-RUN-EXIT.
01494              MOVE 0 TO WS-NOP.
01495          ENC-SBA.
01496              IF EPOS NOT = EA
01497                  MOVE EA TO E-K
01498                  MOVE 17 TO WS-BV
01499                  PERFORM PUT-BYTE
01500                  PERFORM PUT-ADDR.
01501              MOVE 0 TO WS-NOP.
01502          ENC-HI-OFF.
01503              IF EC-HI NOT = 0
01504                  MOVE 0 TO EC-HI
01505                  MOVE 0 TO WS-HV
01506                  PERFORM PUT-HILITE.
01507              MOVE 0 TO WS-NOP.
01508          ENC-SF1.
01509              PERFORM ENC-SBA.
01510              PERFORM ENC-HI-OFF.
01511              MOVE 29 TO WS-BV.
01512              PERFORM PUT-BYTE.
01513              MOVE 96 TO WS-BV.
01514              PERFORM PUT-BYTE.
01515              ADD 1 TO EA.
01516              MOVE EA TO EPOS.
01517          ENC-FLD.
01518              PERFORM ENC-SBA.
01519              PERFORM ENC-HI-OFF.
01520              MOVE 29 TO WS-BV.
01521              PERFORM PUT-BYTE.
01522              MOVE 64 TO WS-BV.
01523              PERFORM PUT-BYTE.
01524              IF WS-HN NOT = 0
01525                  MOVE WS-HN TO WS-HV
01526                  PERFORM PUT-HILITE.
01527              MOVE 19 TO WS-BV.
01528              PERFORM PUT-BYTE.
01529              MOVE 64 TO WS-BV.
01530              PERFORM PUT-BYTE.
01531              IF WS-HN NOT = 0
01532                  MOVE 0 TO WS-HV
01533                  PERFORM PUT-HILITE.
01534              MOVE 29 TO WS-BV.
01535              PERFORM PUT-BYTE.
01536              MOVE 96 TO WS-BV.  28


01537              PERFORM PUT-BYTE.
01538              ADD 3 TO EA.
01539              MOVE EA TO EPOS.
01540          ENC-RUN.
01541              MOVE EA TO ER.
01542              MOVE 0 TO E-DONE.
01543              PERFORM ENC-EXT UNTIL E-DONE = 1.
01544              COMPUTE EL = ER - EA + 1.
01545              MOVE 0 TO E-BLANK.
01546              IF CU-CH (EA) = SPACE AND CU-HI (EA) = 0 AND CU-CS (EA) = 0
01547                  MOVE 1 TO E-BLANK.
01548              IF E-BLANK = 1 AND EL > 3
01549                  COMPUTE EA = ER + 1
01550                  GO TO ENC-RUN-EXIT.
01551              PERFORM ENC-SBA.
01552              IF E-BLANK = 0 AND CU-CO (EA) NOT = EC-CO
01553                  MOVE CU-CO (EA) TO EC-CO
01554                  MOVE EC-CO TO WS-BV
01555                  PERFORM PUT-COLOUR.
01556              IF CU-HI (EA) NOT = EC-HI
01557                  MOVE CU-HI (EA) TO EC-HI
01558                  MOVE EC-HI TO WS-HV
01559                  PERFORM PUT-HILITE.
01560              MOVE 1 TO E-CB.
01561              IF CU-CS (EA) = 1
01562                  MOVE 2 TO E-CB.
01563              COMPUTE EN = EL * E-CB - E-CB.
01564              IF EN > 3
01565                  PERFORM ENC-RA
01566              ELSE
01567                  PERFORM ENC-LIT EL TIMES.
01568              COMPUTE EA = ER + 1.
01569              MOVE EA TO EPOS.
01570          ENC-RUN-EXIT.
01571              EXIT.
01572          ENC-EXT.
01573              COMPUTE EN = ER + 1.
01574              IF EN > VS-N OR EN = E-SP1 OR EN = E-SPF
01575                  MOVE 1 TO E-DONE
01576              ELSE
01577                  PERFORM ENC-CMP.
01578              MOVE 0 TO WS-NOP.
01579          ENC-CMP.
01580              IF CU-CH (EN) NOT = CU-CH (EA)
01581                     OR CU-CO (EN) NOT = CU-CO (EA)
01582                     OR CU-HI (EN) NOT = CU-HI (EA)
01583                     OR CU-CS (EN) NOT = CU-CS (EA)
01584                  MOVE 1 TO E-DONE
01585              ELSE
01586                  MOVE EN TO ER.
01587              MOVE 0 TO WS-NOP.
01588          ENC-RA.
01589         * REPEAT TO ADDRESS X'3C' (THE CELL AFTER THE RUN), [GE] CHAR.
01590              MOVE 60 TO WS-BV.
01591              PERFORM PUT-BYTE.
01592              COMPUTE E-K = ER + 1.
01593              IF E-K > G-CELLS  29


01594                  MOVE 1 TO E-K.
01595              PERFORM PUT-ADDR.
01596              PERFORM ENC-LIT.
01597          ENC-LIT.
01598              IF CU-CS (EA) = 1
01599                  MOVE 8 TO WS-BV
01600                  PERFORM PUT-BYTE.
01601              MOVE CU-CH (EA) TO WS-CHB.
01602              PERFORM PUT-CHB.
01603          PUT-ADDR.
01604         * 12-BIT ADDRESS OF BUFFER CELL E-K (1-4095), TWO BYTES.
01605              COMPUTE WS-ADDR = E-K - 1.
01606              DIVIDE WS-ADDR BY 64 GIVING WS-HI REMAINDER WS-LO.
01607              ADD 1 TO WS-HI.
01608              ADD 1 TO WS-LO.
01609              MOVE ADDR-CODE (WS-HI) TO WS-BV.
01610              PERFORM PUT-BYTE.
01611              MOVE ADDR-CODE (WS-LO) TO WS-BV.
01612              PERFORM PUT-BYTE.
01613         * MVS-GS WIDE / TALL: TITLE (AND THE TALL SCORE LINE).
01614          SHOW-TOP.
01615              COMPUTE WS-ROW = W-B0 - 2.
01616              IF FAM = 'T'
01617                  COMPUTE WS-ROW = W-B0 - 4.
01618              COMPUTE WS-COL = W-C0 + 33.
01619              PERFORM PUT-SBA.
01620              MOVE PAL-PLAYER TO WS-BV.
01621              PERFORM PUT-COLOUR.
01622              MOVE 'P A C - M A N' TO WS-TXT.
01623              MOVE 13 TO WS-TLEN.
01624              PERFORM PUT-TEXT.
01625              IF FAM = 'T'
01626                  PERFORM SHOW-TALL-LINE.
01627              MOVE 0 TO WS-NOP.
01628          SHOW-TALL-LINE.
01629              MOVE SCORE TO TL-SCORE.
01630              MOVE PELLETS-LEFT TO TL-PEL.
01631              MOVE TICK-COUNT TO TL-TURN.
01632              COMPUTE WS-ROW = W-B0 - 2.
01633              COMPUTE WS-COL = W-C0 + 1.
01634              PERFORM PUT-SBA.
01635              MOVE PAL-HUD TO WS-BV.
01636              PERFORM PUT-COLOUR.
01637              MOVE TALL-LINE TO WS-TXT.
01638              MOVE 44 TO WS-TLEN.
01639              PERFORM PUT-TEXT.
01640              COMPUTE W-L = W-C0 + 45.

00047          01  QRY-AREA.
00048              05  QRY-CH            PIC X OCCURS 2048 TIMES.
00049          01  QRY-LEN               PIC S9(4) COMP.
00050          01  QRY-OUT.
00051              05  QO-COLOUR         PIC 9.
00052              05  QO-HILITE         PIC 9.
00053              05  QO-GE             PIC 9.
00054              05  QO-AW             PIC 999.   2


00055              05  QO-AH             PIC 999.
00056          PROCEDURE DIVISION USING QRY-AREA QRY-LEN QRY-OUT.
00057          MAIN-PARA.
00058              MOVE 0 TO QO-COLOUR.
00059              MOVE 0 TO QO-HILITE.
00060              MOVE 0 TO QO-GE.
00061              MOVE 0 TO UA-W UA-H IP-W IP-H.
00062              PERFORM FIND-CAPS THRU FIND-CAPS-EXIT.
00063              MOVE 80 TO QO-AW.
00064              MOVE 24 TO QO-AH.
00065              IF UA-W > 0 AND UA-H > 0 AND UA-W < 1000 AND UA-H < 1000
00066                  MOVE UA-W TO QO-AW
00067                  MOVE UA-H TO QO-AH.
00068              IF IP-W > 0 AND IP-H > 0 AND IP-W < 1000 AND IP-H < 1000
00069                  MOVE IP-W TO QO-AW
00070                  MOVE IP-H TO QO-AH.
00071              GOBACK.
00072          FIND-CAPS.
00073         * QUERY REPLY = AID X'88' (136) + STRUCTURED FIELDS: LENGTH(2),
00074         * X'81' (129), QCODE. COLOUR SUPPORT = QCODE X'86' (134).
00075              IF QRY-LEN < 1
00076                  GO TO FIND-CAPS-EXIT.
00077              MOVE 1 TO WS-K.
00078              PERFORM BYTE-VAL.
00079              IF WS-V NOT = 136
00080                  GO TO FIND-CAPS-EXIT.
00081              MOVE 2 TO WS-P.
00082              MOVE 0 TO WS-STOP.
00083              PERFORM NEXT-SF THRU NEXT-SF-EXIT UNTIL WS-STOP = 1.
00084          FIND-CAPS-EXIT.
00085              EXIT.
00086          NEXT-SF.
00087              COMPUTE WS-LIM = WS-P + 3.
00088              IF WS-LIM > QRY-LEN
00089                  MOVE 1 TO WS-STOP
00090                  GO TO NEXT-SF-EXIT.
00091              MOVE WS-P TO WS-K.
00092              PERFORM BYTE-VAL.
00093              COMPUTE WS-L = WS-V * 256.
00094              ADD 1 TO WS-K.
00095              PERFORM BYTE-VAL.
00096              ADD WS-V TO WS-L.
00097              ADD 1 TO WS-K.
00098              PERFORM BYTE-VAL.
00099              MOVE WS-V TO WS-ID.
00100              ADD 1 TO WS-K.
00101              PERFORM BYTE-VAL.
00102              MOVE WS-V TO WS-QC.
00103              IF WS-ID = 129 AND WS-QC = 134
00104                  MOVE 1 TO QO-COLOUR.
00105              IF WS-ID = 129 AND WS-QC = 135
00106                  MOVE 1 TO QO-HILITE.
00107              IF WS-ID = 129 AND WS-QC = 133 AND WS-L > 13
00108                  PERFORM CHAR-SETS THRU CHAR-SETS-EXIT.
00109              IF WS-ID = 129 AND WS-QC = 129 AND WS-L > 9
00110                  PERFORM USABLE THRU USABLE-EXIT.
00111              IF WS-ID = 129 AND WS-QC = 166 AND WS-L > 16   3


00112                  PERFORM IMPLICIT THRU IMPLICIT-EXIT.
00113              IF WS-L < 4
00114                  MOVE 1 TO WS-STOP
00115              ELSE
00116                  ADD WS-L TO WS-P.
00117          NEXT-SF-EXIT.
00118              EXIT.
00119          CHAR-SETS.
00120         * X'85': FLAGS1 AT +4, DESCRIPTOR LENGTH (DL) AT +12, DESCRIPTORS
00121         * FROM +13 TO THE END OF THE FIELD; THE CGCSGID IS THE LAST FOUR
00122         * BYTES OF A DESCRIPTOR, ITS LAST TWO = CODE PAGE (310 = X'0136').
00123              COMPUTE WS-END = WS-P + WS-L - 1.
00124              IF WS-END > QRY-LEN
00125                  GO TO CHAR-SETS-EXIT.
00126              COMPUTE WS-K = WS-P + 4.
00127              PERFORM BYTE-VAL.
00128              MOVE WS-V TO WS-F1.
00129              IF WS-F1 < 128
00130                  GO TO CHAR-SETS-EXIT.
00131              DIVIDE WS-F1 BY 4 GIVING WS-Q REMAINDER WS-R.
00132              IF WS-R < 2
00133                  GO TO CHAR-SETS-EXIT.
00134              COMPUTE WS-K = WS-P + 12.
00135              PERFORM BYTE-VAL.
00136              MOVE WS-V TO WS-DL.
00137              IF WS-DL < 4
00138                  GO TO CHAR-SETS-EXIT.
00139              COMPUTE WS-D = WS-P + 13.
00140              MOVE 0 TO WS-DSTOP.
00141              PERFORM NEXT-DESC UNTIL WS-DSTOP = 1.
00142          CHAR-SETS-EXIT.
00143              EXIT.
00144          NEXT-DESC.
00145              COMPUTE WS-LIM = WS-D + WS-DL - 1.
00146              IF WS-LIM > WS-END
00147                  MOVE 1 TO WS-DSTOP.
00148              IF WS-DSTOP = 0
00149                  PERFORM DESC-CP.
00150              ADD WS-DL TO WS-D.
00151          DESC-CP.
00152              COMPUTE WS-K = WS-LIM - 1.
00153              PERFORM BYTE-VAL.
00154              COMPUTE WS-CP = WS-V * 256.
00155              ADD 1 TO WS-K.
00156              PERFORM BYTE-VAL.
00157              ADD WS-V TO WS-CP.
00158              IF WS-CP = 310
00159                  MOVE 1 TO QO-GE.
00160              MOVE 0 TO WS-NOP.
00161          USABLE.
00162         * X'81' USABLE AREA: WIDTH AT +6, HEIGHT AT +8 (2 BYTES EACH).
00163              COMPUTE WS-END = WS-P + 9.
00164              IF WS-END > QRY-LEN
00165                  GO TO USABLE-EXIT.
00166              COMPUTE WS-K = WS-P + 6.
00167              PERFORM WORD-VAL.
00168              MOVE WS-W TO UA-W.   4


00169              COMPUTE WS-K = WS-P + 8.
00170              PERFORM WORD-VAL.
00171              MOVE WS-W TO UA-H.
00172          USABLE-EXIT.
00173              EXIT.
00174          IMPLICIT.
00175         * X'A6' IMPLICIT PARTITION: SELF-DEFINING PARAMETER X'01' AT +7,
00176         * ALTERNATE WIDTH AT +13, ALTERNATE HEIGHT AT +15.
00177              COMPUTE WS-END = WS-P + 16.
00178              IF WS-END > QRY-LEN
00179                  GO TO IMPLICIT-EXIT.
00180              COMPUTE WS-K = WS-P + 7.
00181              PERFORM BYTE-VAL.
00182              IF WS-V NOT = 1
00183                  GO TO IMPLICIT-EXIT.
00184              COMPUTE WS-K = WS-P + 13.
00185              PERFORM WORD-VAL.
00186              MOVE WS-W TO IP-W.
00187              COMPUTE WS-K = WS-P + 15.
00188              PERFORM WORD-VAL.
00189              MOVE WS-W TO IP-H.
00190          IMPLICIT-EXIT.
00191              EXIT.
00192          WORD-VAL.
00193              PERFORM BYTE-VAL.
00194              COMPUTE WS-W = WS-V * 256.
00195              ADD 1 TO WS-K.
00196              PERFORM BYTE-VAL.
00197              ADD WS-V TO WS-W.
00198          BYTE-VAL.
00199              MOVE QRY-CH (WS-K) TO HX-B.
00200              MOVE HEXN TO WS-V.   5
